evals.description: Bootstrap — detect-state.cjs + write-state.cjs initialize STATE.md, never hand-rolled
evals.prompt: O usuário invoca /sdd-workflow para a feature docs/payment/checkout. Não existe nenhum STATE.md nesse caminho, mas já existe um PRD.md salvo. O que o orquestrador deve fazer e qual saída deve produzir?
assertions: The output runs detect-state.cjs on docs/payment/checkout before drawing any conclusion about the phase
The output uses write-state.cjs to create and populate STATE.md with the fields the detection script reported, rather than hand-writing STATE.md content in prose
Because PRD.md exists but PLAN.md does not, the output advances to instructing the user to run /sdd-plan, not stopping at the prd phase
The entire user-facing output is written in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)

evals.description: Wave computed via compute-wave.cjs from the persisted wave: field, never recomputed or incremented by hand
evals.prompt: STATE.md tem phase: implement, current_wave: 1. O PLAN.md da feature docs/user/login já tem o campo wave: computado em cada task. Determine a próxima wave executável.
assertions: The output invokes compute-wave.cjs for the feature instead of manually inspecting depends_on/parallel_group to infer the next wave
The output does not increment current_wave by a counter — it treats the wave number as whatever compute-wave.cjs reports from the persisted wave: field
If compute-wave.cjs reports STATUS: deadlock, the output does not silently work around it by estimating an executable task itself
The output states the total number of waves (TOTAL_WAVES) alongside the current one, so the wave's position is never ambiguous

evals.description: Retry counter updated via write-state.cjs --increment-retry, never by hand-editing STATE.md
evals.prompt: Uma task (TASK-APP-LOGIN-HANDLER) falhou na verificação pela primeira vez nesta wave. retry_counts para essa task está ausente em STATE.md (ou seja, 0 tentativas até agora). Aplique a lógica de retry.
assertions: The output increments the retry counter by invoking write-state.cjs --increment-retry TASK-APP-LOGIN-HANDLER, not by describing a manual edit to STATE.md's YAML
Because the count is below 3, the output re-spawns the implement-agent with the failure details as dev_feedback, then re-spawns the verify-agent, rather than reverting the file
The output does not revert the file (git checkout) or mark the task as permanently failed at this retry count
The output waits for both the implement-agent and verify-agent retries to complete before considering the next failed task

evals.description: PLAN.md checkboxes marked via update-plan.cjs, never hand-edited
evals.prompt: Wave 1 da feature docs/order/cancel terminou: TASK-DOM-ORDER-STATUS e TASK-APP-CANCEL-COMMAND obtiveram verdict PASS em modo normal (não yolo). Atualize o PLAN.md e o STATE.md para refletir isso.
assertions: The output marks both tasks as done by invoking update-plan.cjs --mark-done with the passed task IDs, not by describing a direct text edit to PLAN.md's checkboxes
The output does not use --mark-yolo since the run is not in yolo mode
The output updates STATE.md's completed_tasks/pending_tasks via write-state.cjs rather than narrating a manual YAML edit
After updating, the output re-runs compute-wave.cjs to refresh the wave cache instead of assuming the next wave is current_wave + 1 by arithmetic

evals.description: Wave confirmation gate still enforced before spawning subagents, even with scripts computing the wave
evals.prompt: compute-wave.cjs reportou STATUS: ok, WAVE: 2, TOTAL_WAVES: 3, com duas tasks executáveis em parallel_group diferentes para a feature docs/user/login. yolo não foi solicitado. Como o orquestrador deve proceder?
assertions: The output presents the executable tasks grouped by parallel_group, stating the wave's position (Wave 2 de 3), before spawning any subagent
The output explicitly requests user confirmation before spawning any implement-agent or verify-agent
The output does not spawn or claim to have already spawned any subagent without the user's explicit confirmation
The output does not skip the confirmation just because the wave was computed by a script rather than by hand
